description:
Register a number you already own with your carrier, on one of your SIP trunks. Set inbound_agent_id to have an agent answer calls to it; without it inbound calls are rejected. On a trunk whose carrier was connected in one step (it has a carrier), this also points the number at Wixzel Voice at the carrier, and the number must be on that account (see list_carrier_numbers). On a trunk added by hand, the carrier must also be pointed at the trunk's origination_uri (see get_sip_trunk). To buy a new number instead, use search_available_numbers and purchase_phone_number.

Requires scope `phone_numbers:write`.

inbound_agent_id.description: Agent that answers inbound calls to this number.

phone_number.description: Phone number in E.164 form, e.g. "+14155551234".

sip_trunk_id.description: The trunk this number is routed through. See list_sip_trunks.

name: create_phone_number
title: Register a phone number
